verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that the product's own Ryzen AI Software documentation site serves an llms.txt file (HTTP 200 at ryzenai.docs.amd.com/llms.txt), so an agent can be pointed at it. Coverage is limited: the per-page markdown endpoint returns 404, and the probe shows only the file's opening lines, so its depth and completeness are unverified. Missing for 10: markdown versions of the doc pages, evidence of llms.txt content depth and coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
